Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Venkat DSouza. I am a 24-year-old cardiologist living in Coimbatore. Shalini Khan gave me a cheque for INR 16,10,000/- to repay a loan, but the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 66266 35168 or email venkat.dsouza@example.com.
